title: policies
description: The head policy (the owner, 2026-11-04 and 2026-11-13): a head's indication is a lookup of the mast's indication, the head count, the head number and the context. Rows keyed by rulebook (the context today), then head count, then the mast's indication, each the head word of every position top down. A mast with no row for its rulebook and head count derives no shows; nothing is inferred.

table.description: The table's name, the file's stem; provenance.referenceData of a layout file names it.

schemaVersion.description: The version of this schema the file is written to. 0 until the KiCad importer and FieldUnit work end to end; no bump rules before then (the owner, 2026-11-13).

version.description: The table's provenance date, with .n when it was revised again that day. A layout file names it in provenance.referenceData.<table>.version.

provenance.description: Where the rows come from: the owner's ruling, the document and date, or the standard opened.

items.description: An indication word of the FieldUnit vocabulary (docs/GLOSSARY.md), or DARK.

rows.description: Keyed by rulebook, then head count as a string, then mast indication.
